import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import os

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
OUTPUT_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "submission.csv")
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

# Get column names from sample submission
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
id_col = sample_sub.columns[0]

# Target columns are already binary integers
y_binary = train_df[target_cols].copy()
y_binary = y_binary.astype(int)
y_binary.columns = target_cols

# Create validation set BEFORE training (genuine hold-out)
X_text_train, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["comment_text"],
    y_binary,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
)

# Feature engineering with TF-IDF and character n-grams - NO STOP WORDS
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=100000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words=None
)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(1, 5),
    max_features=200000,
    min_df=1,
)

X_word_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_text_train)
X_word_val = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)
X_word_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

X_char_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_text_train)
X_char_val = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)
X_char_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

# Combine word and character features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_word_train, X_char_train])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_word_val, X_char_val])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_word_test, X_char_test])

# Train model ONLY on training data WITH balanced class weights
clf = OneVsRestClassifier(LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, class_weight="balanced"))
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train.values)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set (genuine hold-out)
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_auc_scores = []
for i in range(len(target_cols)):
    val_auc_scores.append(roc_auc_score(y_val.iloc[:, i], val_probs[:, i]))
mean_val_auc = np.mean(val_auc_scores)
print(f"Column-wise ROC AUC on hold-out validation set: {mean_val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Save to submission file in ./submission/ directory
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df[id_col].values})
for i in range(len(target_cols)):
    column_name = target_cols[i]
    submission[column_name] = test_preds[:, i].clip(0, 1)

submission.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
